name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam's journey into motorsport started with a childhood fascination for hot rods. He spent countless hours in his grandfather's garage, learning the art of bodywork and paint. This passion led him to pursue formal training in automotive refinishing, where he honed his skills and developed an eye for detail. Liam joined Akkodis ASP Team five years ago, drawn by their commitment to excellence and innovation. 

As a paint shop specialist, Liam is responsible for ensuring that every car leaving his bay looks pristine and reflects the team's brand identity. He takes pride in his ability to match colors precisely and apply finishes that enhance both the aesthetic appeal and aerodynamic performance of the vehicles. Liam is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to quality. He consistently seeks out new techniques and materials to improve his work and stay ahead of the curve, ensuring the team's cars always present a professional image. 

Liam's dedication to perfection and relentless pursuit of innovation sets him apart. He's not just a painter; he's an artist who understands the importance of his craft in the high-stakes world of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part
physical.description: Liam is a solidly built man with a focused gaze and a steady hand, radiating both confidence and competence.

quirks: Always wears a pristine white lab coat, even when mixing paints.
Has a habit of humming classic rock tunes while working.
Insists on using a specific brand of detailing brushes imported from Japan.
